description:
Median annual earnings in New Zealand, by region, age band or sex.

    Use for: 'median income nz', 'average salary nz', 'median salary nz 2024',
    'average income by age nz', 'median wage canterbury', 'what is a good
    salary in nz'.

    Stats NZ LEED medians, tax years 2000 to 2024. Give region OR age_band (not
    both), and optionally sex. The median counts everyone with that income in the
    year, including part-time and part-year earners, so it sits well below a
    full-time salary; say so when answering a salary question.

    Args:
        region: A region, for example Canterbury.
        age_band: An age band, for example 25-29.
        sex: all, male or female.
        income_source: wages, self_employment or total.
        tax_year: 2000 to 2024. Omitted, the latest.

    Returns:
        The published median and the same median in the latest quarter's dollars.
name: nz_median_earnings_calculator
